papers.title: Introspective X Training: Feedback Conditioning Improves Scaling Across All LLM Training Stages
papers.what: Prefix-conditions pretraining data with reward-model feedback; 2.8x compute efficiency on 7.5-12B transformers trained to 18T tokens.

papers.title: Nexus: An Agentic Framework for Time Series Forecasting
papers.what: Multi-agent LLM forecasting that decomposes prediction into macro, micro, and contextual stages; matches TSFMs zero-shot.

papers.title: Resolving Action Bottleneck: Agentic RL Informed by Token-Level Energy
papers.what: Shows action tokens carry most learning signal in agent trajectories; token reweighting yields +65pp over PPO.

papers.title: AudioMosaic: Contrastive Masked Audio Representation Learning
papers.what: Masking-as-augmentation for contrastive audio pretraining; SOTA on audio benchmarks, outperforms generative SSL.
